cohort: Women in the US who had never before given birth (N = 101 for initial survey, N = 58 for post-birth survey).
finding: Regression analysis indicated that only childbirth fear significantly predicted subjective childbirth experiences.
cross-section timing: Exposures measured in the third trimester of pregnancy (range 28-40 weeks gestation).
gest_age: 28-40 weeks gestation (at time of exposure measurement)
